purpose: Compose the source-only VNAV-00 synthetic fixture into deterministic route, map-match, reroute, ETA, attention, prepared-message, detour, currentness and privacy receipts without invoking a real navigation effect.

reuse feature.vexlife.addressed-conversation instead of creating a messaging ontology
consume accepted ENS-N1, FO-N1, EWA and VexInterface semantics only by source ref
resolve all route/map/currentness inputs from the caller-supplied synthetic fixture
perform no external map, routing, geocoder, network, sensor or model lookup
preconditions: map-pack and routing-graph currentness are explicit
web place candidates are not trusted coordinates until locally resolved
raw search retention is EPHEMERAL or SESSION
real GPS, network, message-send and vehicle-control effects are false

closureRule: VNAV-00 closes only when every permanent distinction and held-effect negative control is explicit in the deterministic receipt
recoveryRule: discard the synthetic receipt and recompose from current source refs; never retain precise trip/search/location history as recovery state
